verdictBasis: Exact frozen candidate/evidence/audit baseline only; no candidate, Registry, approved meaning, or production mutation.

targets.conciseReason: Direction/goal, adversative relation, and topic/relation are preserved as syntactic-contextual functions rather than inflated Korean-particle senses.
The basic relative marker is kept distinct from בַאֲשֶׁר, כַּאֲשֶׁר, and מֵאֲשֶׁר construction-level renderings, preventing sense inflation.
Totality, distributive use, and indefinite renderings are bounded by construct/article scope and context instead of being treated as unrelated lexical senses.
Qal/Hiphil/Hophal stem boundaries and motion/causation are explicitly separated; the Hiphil-heavy Genesis sample does not redefine the lemma globally.
Negation scope is treated syntactically and Korean renderings such as 없다/없이 are not promoted into unsupported independent senses.
Gender/reference distinctions are preserved while emphatic, resumptive, and copular translation effects remain discourse/syntactic functions rather than asserted lexical meanings.
Proper-name identity remains primary and heel/follow/supplant etymological material is confined to provenance/notes rather than replacing the headword meaning.
Literal brother, wider male kinship, and community extensions are context-bounded, and possessive suffixes are correctly treated as morphology rather than lexical senses.
Birth, begetting, passive birth, midwifery, and causative uses are explicitly tied to stem, subject role, and context without theological expansion.
Core year meaning is preserved and age/duration expressions are correctly treated as constructional uses unless stronger evidence requires a separate boundary.
